train_seed_rule: train seed = eval seed; evaluation seed = train seed + 20000
split: same 4 generated fault families; shuffled filenames; separate training/evaluation tasks
candidate_cost_unit: one attempted code edit and public test evaluation = 1 proxy unit
claim_boundary: Synthetic six-file Python repositories with fixed role APIs, single faults, a supplied patch vocabulary, and PUBLIC module-level contract probes. Probes have predeclared abstract costs, not measured CPU or energy. Training uses WITNESS-supported repaired locations; no evaluation fault labels are available to the planner. The same generated scenario families are present across train/evaluation, so results do not establish transfer to arbitrary repositories or truly novel causal concepts. The probe author knows reference behavior and the tester executes source in process; unsafe external repos are not supported by this demo.
